title: Text and image services get a sturdier test net
summary:
A maintenance-forward day: stronger text and image tests, plus generated Mentat Scripts.

The text and image backends gained dedicated test workflows, expanded seed coverage, and repaired test suites. Less glamorous than a new endpoint, but useful: generated results now have more automated checks standing between a change and a surprise.

Added generation support for Mentat Scripts, giving the project another way to turn prompts into usable code-shaped output.
